# Eos

---

The Eos is a Gallente command ship used as a booster in armor fleets. It provides armor command bursts and remote sensor boosts to support the fleet.

## Key Points

- Keep your command bursts cycling at all times.
- Run Armor Command Bursts (Armor Energizing, Rapid Repair, Armor Reinforcement) and Skirmish bursts (Interdiction Maneuvers).
- Use your Sentient Remote Sensor Boosters to help the DDD lock targets faster (3).
- You have a Micro Jump Drive — use it to position or regroup effectively.
- Stay aligned and avoid drawing aggro.
- Keep charges stocked.
- You are required to use a Federation Navy Command Mindlink on this toon.

## Positioning

TPPH - Room 1 and 2 burn to the out gate. Room 3 burn up and left of the tower, near where the nestor's are parked. You can also MJD here just make sure you aren't jumping straight forward unless you are the meatshield. 

NRF - Burn 70 Kilometers straight forward (or MJD and burn back 20ish kilometers.)

TCRC - Burn to the left of the tower and turn off your prop mod. You can also MJD here.

If you there are no other boosters in the fleet then you need to meatshield. Remove 1 remote sensor booster and fit the Medium Micro Jump Drive.

TPPH- Room 1 and 2 burn to the out gate. Room 3 mjd straight forward then burn back, down and to the right of the tower so your ship is on the opposite side of the tower as the fleet at the bottom of the tower.

NRF- Burn directly beneath (about 5km below) the right most tower in the group of three towers at the front of the room, this is roughly 55km forward, slightly left and down.

TCRC- slide the gate, q-align backwards and call the site. When your speed starts increasing again (be certain your q-align went through) press your MJD. Once you've jumped control space (or drift backwards). Do not prop mod after jumping, this is boomer tech that is objectively bad.
